title: The flats at night
logline: The flats at night in August, the first night walk the book takes: the mud silver, the chimney a black bar, the pup a shape, the man a shape. The glow above the ridge at the top edge. The page lets it in, once, from below.

panels.composition: Mudflats at night under a moon, silver mud, the chimney a black bar across the bay, a man and an old three-legged dog as dark shapes, and at the top edge a warm glow over the ridge.
props: the glow, at the top edge
